Also the 3px field focus halo (shadow focus-ring-field). Not a Brand Book value. Source: custom.css .coverage-honesty, .form-error, .legal-contact-line, .privacy-note.

tokens.name: accent-4
tokens.usage: Site accent edge: border-left 4px solid var(--orange) on .services-mid-cta (its other three sides 1px orange 55%, colour token services-mid-cta-border). Not a Brand Book value (the book's "Rule 4 px" on p22 is a corner radius — radius-rule). Source: custom.css .services-mid-cta.

tokens.name: ignition-rule-width
tokens.usage: Brand Book p22 "Ignition rule 96 × 5 px under headings" — the short orange rule under every page title (visible on every page image). Width; pair with ignition-rule-height. Not on the site: the site draws its orange rule before the eyebrow (eyebrow-rule-width/height), never under headings — §9 row 21, for Andries Liebenberg.

tokens.name: ignition-rule-height
tokens.usage: Brand Book p22 "Ignition rule 96 × 5 px under headings" — height (thickness) of the ignition rule in Ignition Orange; pair with ignition-rule-width.

tokens.name: eyebrow-rule-width
tokens.usage: Site: .hero-kicker::before and .eyebrow::before draw a 2.5rem × 1px block of var(--orange) (background, not a border) before the label, margin-right .8rem. Width (2.5rem = 40px); pair with eyebrow-rule-height. Source: custom.css .hero-kicker:before,.eyebrow:before.

tokens.name: eyebrow-rule-height
tokens.usage: Site: height of the 2.5rem × 1px orange dash before every eyebrow/kicker (.hero-kicker::before, .eyebrow::before); pair with eyebrow-rule-width. Source: custom.css .hero-kicker:before,.eyebrow:before.
